documents.title: Guidelines on the Use of Generative AI in Curriculum
tiers: Option 1: Prohibited - No Use of GAI
Option 2: Permitted with Full Disclosure and Reflection
documents.summary: Faculty Senate guidelines endorsed Dec 2025 for generative AI in curriculum. They set student and faculty obligations, lists of acceptable and prohibited uses, and three sample syllabus statements (prohibit, permit with disclosure, permit with limits), leaving each course's rule to the instructor.
documents.stance_why: The document says it provides 'faculty the freedom to set course policies' and offers three syllabus options (prohibited, permitted with full disclosure, permitted with specific limitations); it sets no single stance, though use is 'only acceptable if clearly established by the course instructor', so it delegates with tiers.
